Senior Operations Manager - Supply & Fulfilment
  
  

* Fulfilment
* United Arab Emirates
* Justlife

Justlife (previously Justmop) is the Middle East’s leading marketplace for home cleaning, beauty & wellness, and other home services such as laundry, maintenance & repairs, upholstery cleaning, pest control & disinfection, moving and packing, and car cleaning, and more. Justlife’s long-term vision is to become a super app for everything related to home services. When a customer books a cleaner or driver, they’re not just booking a service - they’re trusting us to show up.
  
  
Our Mission: We promise our customers stellar service, our suppliers a valuable partner, our professionals a better life, and our employees a work environment where they can be the best versions of themselves. Our mission contributes to having a fulfilling workplace for the tribe.
  
  
As a Senior Operations Manager - Supply & Fulfilment, you will be responsible for both strategic planning and hands-on operational execution along with managing the outsourced agent team. You’re the central point of contact for fulfilment excellence across the UAE, touching thousands of bookings every week.
  
  
You’ll love this role if you...
  
  

* You get into raw data, diagnose root causes, and fix the structure - not just the symptom
* You’re equally comfortable going to the details (van calendars, attendance, timing changes in the CRM) and big-picture strategy (service launches, seasonal planning, demand forecasting)
* You have an obsession with automation and setting up ops processes to streamline execution
* You work collaboratively with other stakeholders (both internal and external)
* You own the metrics and projects end to end and take decisions independently to fix and improve

What you’ll own
  
  

* Manage supply distribution in different micro-markets across all cities to rebalance capacity based on demand patterns
* Lead and manage the outsourced agent team: assign tasks, track weekly productivity (tasks per agent, turnaround time, quality), and identify automation opportunities to lift their output
* Own fulfilment metrics end-to-end: delivery %, cancellation %, utilisation and capacity by hub and zone. You’ll report on these weekly, analyse trends by service type, and drive improvement through both daily execution and structural fixes
* Manage van operations: calendars, professional attendance, timing changes and operational scheduling.
* Automate repeatable processes: identify manual workflows, build or implement solutions
* Execute key projects end-to-end: new service launches, seasonal demand and supply planning cycles, and vacation planning. You’ll own timelines, stakeholder coordination and on-time delivery

What tells us you’re the one
  
  

* You have 4–6+ years in operations, supply planning, fulfilment or last-mile delivery, ideally in a marketplace, home services or logistics business.
* You’ve demonstrated extreme ownership and measurably improved operational metrics across a scaled operation
* You’ve been tried and tested on problem-solving skills and worked on large operational data to drive insights
* You’ve a strong bias for action - you diagnose the issue, then go and fix it on the ground
* You’ve managed a team or outsourced workforce before and you know how to track performance, set clear expectations and automate what’s repeatable
* You’re based in or willing to relocate to the UAE. You speak English fluently. UAE experience in home services, facilities management or last-mile delivery is a plus, not required

Why Justlife
  
  

* Scale and impact: Your work directly touches thousands of bookings every week across multiple service types. Delivery % and cancellation % improvements show up in customer satisfaction, repeat bookings and revenue
* Real growth: You’ll move into larger scope as we expand across the GCC. Fulfilment is core to our scaling strategy, and exceptional performance here opens doors to leadership roles
* Ownership and autonomy: You own the metrics and the levers. No micromanagement. You diagnose, you decide, you execute
* A fair, objective performance system: Monthly KPI-based bonus. Clear metrics, clear payoff. Recognition through our JustHeroes program for impact that matters
* Start-up spirit, plus perks: a birthday day off (JustHoliday), free Justlife credits, referral bonuses, team experiences and mentorship from founders and leadership

The Head of IT Data Governance reports to the Group Head of IT and Security and is accountable for the quality, consistency and usability of the data the IT function relies on to run and improve itself. The role involves leading the IT Data Programme and establishing and sustaining an IT data governance capability that keeps the data model accurate.
  
  
This is a governance role, not a data ownership role. The IT leader accountable for a service remains accountable for the data supporting that service (e.g. the Head of IT Infrastructure and Networks owns infrastructure and identity data, the Head of IT Platforms owns platform and application data, etc.). This role is responsible for implementing and operationalising data governance across IT, in accordance with the Enterprise Data Governance framework, policies and standards. It works closely with the Enterprise Data lead to ensure alignment with enterprise governance, data quality, metadata and information management requirements.
  
  
The role develops IT-specific controls within the enterprise framework, measures compliance, reports performance and escalates non-compliance through agreed arrangements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead the IT Data Programme
  

* Own delivery of the IT Data Programme end to end, including the traceability model, the roadmap and the implementation backlog that follows.
* Make sure the programme answers the business questions IT needs answered and doesn't become a documentation exercise. Every data requirement should be traced to a question and every gap to a prioritised action.
* Turn assessment findings into a sequenced backlog with named owners and see it through to completion.

Implement and operate the data governance framework
  

* Implement and operationalise the enterprise Data Governance Framework within IT. Support the nomination of named Data Owners, Stewards and Custodians across in-scope IT data domains, consistent with enterprise roles, responsibilities, standards and decision rights.
* Apply enterprise data governance decision rights, escalation pathways and dispute resolution processes to IT data domains, escalating cross-functional matters through the established enterprise governance arrangements.
* Set up and chair an IT Data Governance forum that makes decisions instead of reviewing status, aligned with the Enterprise Data Governance Framework and the governance arrangements led by the Enterprise Data team. Oversee IT data quality, stewardship, compliance and remediation through the forum.
* Support the identification of a network of data stewards in each IT function, and support their training, standards and ways of working.
* Hold Data Owners to account for the quality of their domains and report non-compliance through appropriate escalations.

Maintain IT data standards, definitions and authoritative sources
  

* Develop and maintain the IT domain-specific data definitions, metadata, reference data and lifecycle requirements in accordance with enterprise data standards established by the Enterprise Data team, working closely with Enterprise Architecture and relevant Data Owners.
* Maintain the catalogue of IT systems of record and their authoritative data sources, ensuring alignment with the enterprise data catalogue and metadata standards. Identify and resolve IT-specific source conflicts, escalating cross-domain ownership or authoritative source disputes through enterprise data governance.
* Ensure that IT data assets, ownership, classifications, definitions and lineage are maintained in the enterprise data catalogue, working with the Enterprise Data team to establish consistent metadata and assurance requirements.
* Govern alignment to the ServiceNow Common Service Data Model, ensuring the CMDB conforms to the enterprise IT data model rather than diverging from it.
* Apply the existing data standards that system integrations, platform changes and new tooling must meet before approval.

Data quality, measurement and remediation
  

* Implement the enterprise data quality framework across IT data domains, developing domain-specific rules, thresholds, controls and KPIs in collaboration with IT Data Owners and Stewards, consistent with enterprise data quality standards and reporting requirements.
* Establish ongoing data quality measurement and remediation across IT data domains, using enterprise-approved methodologies and integrating results into enterprise data quality reporting and assurance processes.
* Drive remediation of quality failures through the accountable Data Owner, escalating where remediation does not happen.
* Operate the IT data certification process, so users of the data know which data they can trust.
* Operate the information lifecycle for IT data, including retention, archiving and disposal, in line with Information Security policy.
* Build data literacy across IT leadership so Data Owners understand and can discharge their accountability.
* Publish and track an IT data maturity assessment, with a target state and a measurable trajectory.

Reporting and insight
  

* Lead the development of trusted IT management reporting and performance measures, ensuring alignment with enterprise data architecture, common definitions, semantic standards and approved reporting platforms, in collaboration with Enterprise Data and Enterprise Architecture. * Reduce reporting duplication across the function, retiring competing versions of the same measure.
* Provide the data foundation that lets IT quantify its impact on business productivity in hours and cost.

Enable AI and automation

Role summary

The Process Coordinator leads AI-led process redesign. The role takes each business process cuts it down to the steps and fields that matter, gets the rules built into Zoho CRM, and replaces manual reports with live, AI-generated dashboards for each department and role.

The goal is simple: people put the right data in the right place at the right time, and AI turns it into decisions. Managers and coordinators should stop building reports and chasing updates by hand.

This is a process and data role, not a training role. The right person reads workflows and Zoho logic, thinks in fields and data, and is comfortable shortening a process and challenging a manager when a step adds no value.

Key responsibilities1. Process redesign

* Map each current process end to end from the CRM field list, the current SOP and how the team actually works.

* Cut steps and fields that do not feed a decision or a report.

* Set one owner and one time limit for every stage.

* Define the blocking rules the CRM must enforce (for example, no case closes without evidence; no paid job closes without an invoice number), each with a logged override.

* Link modules so data flows without re-entry (for example, case to invoice; confirmed deal to PRQ, PO and delivery).

* Write the one-page SOP for each process: stage, owner, time limit, what must exist before moving on, and what is automatic.

* Take each redesign to the department head and the fortnightly Signal review for approval; L&D then signs off the final SOP.

2. Live dashboards with AI tools

* Own the live dashboards produced through AI tools and Zoho Analytics.

* Assign department-specific and role-specific dashboards: what a sales coordinator, a manager, a division manager and a department head each need to see every day.

* Use the dashboards in real-time reviews and daily huddles so discussions run on live data, not on spreadsheets prepared the night before.

* Set up daily exception lists and weekly reports pulled automatically from the CRM and from source documents (SOPs, POs, invoices, PRQs), so nobody types the same data twice.

* Check data quality before trusting a dashboard: blocking rules come before dashboards, because AI on bad data gives confident wrong answers.

3. Less manual work

* Find every manual report, Excel tracker and repeated hand-off in each department and replace it with a dashboard or an automatic summary.

* Formally retire the old report the day the new dashboard goes live, so teams do not run both.

* Work with IT to clean up automatic tasks that a CRM rule can replace, and raise on-time completion of tasks.

* Track and report manual reporting hours removed.

4. Rollout and adoption

* Run the 8-step redesign cycle for each process: AI baseline audit, design, build, pilot, measure, fix, roll out, retire the old way.

* Write clear build requirements for IT (fields, module links, Blueprint rules, automations) and test them before go-live.

* Support DMs and department heads, who own adoption in their teams.

* Prepare and present at the fortnightly Signal review with senior leadership and IT: designs for approval, blockers and numbers against baseline.

Role requirements

* Can read a Zoho CRM module (fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflows) and explain what it does and where it breaks.

* Can take a field list and an SOP and produce a shorter, rule-based process on paper within a day.

* Uses AI tools daily for analysis, summaries and dashboards, and knows how to check their output.

* Comfortable telling a senior manager that a step or a report should go, and backing it with data.

* Measures improvement as numbers against a baseline, not opinions.

* Leads change across departments and holds a redesign under challenge from senior managers, with the Sponsor's backing.

* Fluent written and spoken English; Arabic or Hindi is a plus.

Education

**Required**

Industry experience

* **4-6 years** in process improvement, business analysis, CRM operations or sales/service operations.

* At least **2 years hands-on with a CRM**, ideally Zoho CRM (Salesforce or Dynamics also acceptable).

The Head of IT Data Governance reports to the Group Head of IT and Security and is accountable for the quality, consistency and usability of the data the IT function relies on to run and improve itself. The role involves leading the IT Data Programme and establishing and sustaining an IT data governance capability that keeps the data model accurate.

This is a governance role, not a data ownership role. The IT leader accountable for a service remains accountable for the data supporting that service (e.g. the Head of IT Infrastructure and Networks owns infrastructure and identity data, the Head of IT Platforms owns platform and application data, etc.). This role is responsible for implementing and operationalising data governance across IT, in accordance with the Enterprise Data Governance framework, policies and standards. It works closely with the Enterprise Data lead to ensure alignment with enterprise governance, data quality, metadata and information management requirements.

The role develops IT-specific controls within the enterprise framework, measures compliance, reports performance and escalates non-compliance through agreed arrangements.

Lead the IT Data Programme

* Review vessel specifications, including carrying capacity, vessel age, technical suitability and cargo-handling capabilities.
* Coordinate vessel nominations and ensure that vessels are secured within the required trading schedules.
* Maintain a reliable database of available vessels, owners, brokers and shipping contacts.

* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of the international oil shipping and tanker markets.

The Subject Matter Expert – Security Operations Center (SOC) oversees advanced security monitoring and incident management activities within the Cyber Security function. This role serves as the primary escalation point for complex or high-severity security incidents, providing technical leadership and validation before handover to Incident Response teams.
  
  
The SME leads deep-dive investigations using SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, endpoint detection, and network telemetry, and applies frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and DEFEND to strengthen threat-hunting and detection coverage. The role is responsible for designing, tuning, and validating detection rules, developing and maintaining SOC playbooks and runbooks, and ensuring effective monitoring across hybrid infrastructures (on-prem, cloud, and telco cloud).
  
  
In addition, the SME mentors SOC engineers, conducts trainings and technical workshops, drives automation opportunities (SOAR playbooks and workflows), and contributes to continuous improvement of SOC processes and content. The role also monitors threat intelligence, tracks emerging threats and vulnerabilities, and communicates findings through clear reports and presentations to security leadership and stakeholders. The SME may participate in RFP processes, providing technical input to help select best-fit security solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary contact for advanced security monitoring, threat detection, and investigation methodologies.
* Lead and supervise team members to ensure effective incident detection and response.
* Provide technical guidance and escalation support to SOC analysts for complex or high-severity incidents.
* Act as the final technical validation authority before escalating to Incident Response (IR) teams.
* Utilize the MITRE ATT&CK and DEFEND frameworks to map detected threats and enhance threat-hunting capabilities.
* Lead in-depth analysis of security events from multiple sources, such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewall logs, endpoint detection tools, and network traffic data.
* Conduct deep-dive technical investigations for high-impact or ambiguous alerts.
* Identify gaps in detection coverage and recommend improvements.
* Continuously support the content development team by recommending detection rule tuning to reduce false positives and by proposing new advanced correlation rules, behavioral detections, and anomaly-based use cases.
* Develop and maintain SOC playbooks and runbooks to ensure consistent investigation standards.
* Ensure effective detection and monitoring across hybrid environments, including on-premises, cloud, and telco cloud.
* Support SOC shift staff in maintaining SLA compliance.
* Review and quality-check investigation reports before closure.
* Participate in major incident calls as the SOC technical lead.
* Conduct post-incident detection gap analysis.
* Mentor analysts and organize trainings to maintain team expertise.
* Develop knowledge articles, technical documentation, and use-case libraries.
* Lead internal technical workshops and purple-team collaboration exercises.
* Monitor and analyze threat intelligence feeds, security blogs, and industry news to stay informed on emerging threats and vulnerabilities.
* Communicate findings through detailed, high-quality reports and presentations to security teams, management, and relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in the RFP process to provide technical recommendations and propose best-fit solutions.

**Qualifications**
**Formal Education Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

**Related Professional Training, Certification Or Membership**

* Cybersecurity-related certification(s).

**Preferred**

* Splunk training

**Job-Specific Competencies**

* Mandatory: Team Lead experience
* Deep experience in monitoring and interpreting SIEM outputs, including log correlation, alert triage, and threat prioritization.
* Ability to design, validate, and tune detection rules and alerts for multiple platforms (SIEM, EDR, NDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls).
* Advanced log analysis skills across endpoints, network, identity systems, and cloud environments.
* Experience with SIEM technologies such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc., EDR, and Threat Intelligence Platforms.
* Proficiency in building and executing complex queries (KQL, SPL, or vendor-specific languages) for detection and investigation.

* Strong knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, FTP, SMTP) and the ability to identify malicious activity patterns.
* Ability to analyze threat intelligence feeds and apply IOC/TTP indicators to operational detection logic.
* Expertise in monitoring Anti-DDoS solutions and understanding mitigation at an operational level.
* Strong capability to validate alerts and investigation outputs from SOC engineers to ensure quality and accuracy.

The role coordinates technical, commercial, financial, procurement, legal and delivery inputs across InfraX's connectivity, telecommunications, IoT, managed services and digital infrastructure portfolio. * Lead bid lifecycle: Own qualification, bid planning, compliance, response development, reviews, approvals, submission, clarification, negotiation and handover for RFIs, RFPs, tenders and direct proposals.
* Establish governance: Create the bid plan, responsibility matrix, review gates, document controls, risk log and approval path; ensure adherence to customer instructions and InfraX governance.
* Shape the win strategy: Define customer value proposition, differentiators, competitive positioning, partners, commercial approach and executive messaging with the opportunity owner.
* Translate needs into solutions: Structure customer business, technical, operational, security, service-level and implementation requirements into a coherent solution and scope of work.
* Cover InfraX environment: Coordinate solutions spanning fiber and managed connectivity, MPLS and enterprise networks, IoT and sensor ecosystems, LoRaWAN/RF mesh, private LTE/5G, cloud/edge, platforms, systems integration, professional services, operations and support.
* Maintain traceability: Use compliance matrices, assumptions, exclusions, interfaces, dependencies and acceptance criteria to keep the solution complete and auditable.
* Architect one integrated offer: Combine InfraX capabilities with multiple OEMs, technology vendors, telecom operators, cloud providers, system integrators, subcontractors and affiliates into one end-to-end solution.
* Align responsibilities: Define work packages, bills of materials, partner scopes, interfaces, warranties, SLAs, support models, delivery obligations and a clear RACI.
* Validate third-party inputs: Obtain and challenge quotations, technical compliance, lead times, dependencies, licensing, support, validity and contractual flow-downs; remove gaps, overlaps and unpriced exposure, vendor price protection.
* Build the business case: Develop CAPEX/OPEX, one-time and recurring revenue models, total contract value, cost-to-serve, gross margin, cash flow, payback, NPV/IRR where applicable, sensitivity scenarios and funding requirements.
* Design commercial models: Structure outright purchase, subscription, managed service, lease, consumption-based, revenue-share, project-finance or public-private-partnership approaches where relevant.
* Protect profitability: Validate pricing, mark-ups, contingencies, taxes, foreign exchange, escalation, payment milestones, performance securities, penalties and working-capital exposure with Finance and Procurement.
* Produce quality submissions: Lead clear, persuasive and compliant technical and commercial proposals, executive summaries, implementation plans, pricing schedules, presentations and clarification responses.
* Coordinate reviews: Consolidate inputs from Sales, Technology, Operations, Project Delivery, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Risk and partners; close review comments before approval.
* Support negotiations: Manage clarifications, best-and-final offers and scope or price revisions while maintaining an approved negotiation position and complete decision record.
* Delivery Planning: Ideation to Execution
* Design for execution: Define delivery strategy, work breakdown, resources, milestones, dependencies, procurement lead times, testing, commissioning, migration, acceptance, training, transition and service commencement.
* Assure deliverability: Validate capacity, resources, permits, access, logistics, cybersecurity, safety, operational readiness and vendor commitments before submission.
* Handover to delivery: Conduct a formal post-award handover covering the baseline scope, contract, cost model, schedule, risks, assumptions, obligations, acceptance criteria and change-control process.
* Align commercial milestones: Structure contractual deliverables and customer acceptance evidence to enable accurate invoicing and revenue recognition in coordination with Finance.
* Track financial realization: Maintain visibility of purchase orders, supplier commitments, delivery and acceptance status, billing milestones, invoices, receivables and collection risks from award to closure.
* Resolve blockers: Coordinate with the customer and internal teams to close documentation, acceptance, dispute and dependency issues that delay billing, revenue recognition or collection.
* Manage bid security requirements: Identify bid bond, performance bond and advance payment guarantee requirements in each tender; confirm amounts, validity periods, issuing-bank conditions and required wording.
* Coordinate issuance: Work with Finance, Treasury, Legal and banks to request, issue, amend, extend and submit bonds and guarantees ahead of bid deadlines, within approved limits and delegated authority.
* Track and release: Maintain a bond register covering value, issuing bank, expiry, renewal and release status; follow up on return or release after award or non-award, and coordinate conversion to performance securities on award.
* Manage bid and delivery risk: Identify commercial, technical, contractual, regulatory, financial, schedule, dependency and supplier risks; define owners, mitigations, contingencies and escalation points.
* Maintain compliance: Coordinate required legal, regulatory, information-security, data, insurance, bonding and customer-specific compliance, with all commitments made within delegated authority.
* Improve performance: Maintain reusable content, solution and pricing references, vendor intelligence, lessons learned and bid metrics; conduct win/loss and post-bid reviews.

* Minimum Experience: 8 years or more in bid management, solutioning, presales, commercial management, project delivery or business development within telecommunications, ICT, IoT, managed services or infrastructure; experience leading complex multi-vendor bids is strongly preferred.

**Job Description:**

**1. Job Purpose**
------------------

To carry out all surveying, setting-out verification, and dimensional control activities ensuring that the Contractor's setting-out, levels, alignments, and as-built records comply with the approved IFC drawings, project specifications, and the requirements of the Client and relevant Dubai authorities (DM, RTA, DEWA). The Land Surveyor provides the Resident Engineer with independent verification of all survey-related works and ensures full traceability to the Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) coordinate system and DMD (Dubai Municipality Datum) vertical datum.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

**2.1 Survey Control & Datum**

* Establish, verify, and maintain primary and secondary survey control networks on site, tied to DLTM and DMD via Dubai Municipality benchmarks.
* Carry out periodic verification of control stations to confirm stability and accuracy.
* Maintain the Project Control Register, including coordinates, elevations, descriptions, and check records.
* Verify the Contractor's survey control submissions and recommend approval to the Resident Engineer.

**2.2 Setting-Out Verification**

* Independently check the Contractor's setting-out of roads, bridges, tunnels, structures, drainage, and utility corridors against approved IFC drawings.
* Verify horizontal alignment, vertical alignment, cross-sections, super-elevation, gradients, and chainages.
* Sign off setting-out check sheets prior to commencement of works and maintain the setting-Out Register.
* Issue Survey Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) where setting out does not comply with approved drawings or tolerances.

**2.3 Roadworks Surveying**

* Verify levels and lines for subgrade, subbase, aggregate base course (ABC), and asphalt layers (binder and wearing course).
* Check kerbs, gullies, channels, manhole covers, road markings, and signage positions.
* Confirm camber, crossfall, super-elevation transitions, and gradient compliance with approved geometric design.
* Carry out asphalt level checks before and after paving to verify thickness compliance.

**2.4 Bridges & Structures**

* Verify setting-out and levels for piles, pile caps, piers, abutments, bearings, girders, deck slabs, parapets, and expansion joints.
* Check geometric control of formwork, falsework, and reinforcement positioning.
* Carry out monitoring surveys for movement, settlement, and deflection of structures during and after construction.
* Verify final geometry of bridge decks, including camber, alignment, and joint positions.

**2.5 Tunnels**

* Verify tunnel alignment control, including horizontal and vertical setting-out of the tunnel axis.
* Check setting-out for segmental linings, cross-passages, shafts, portals, and tunnel finishes.
* Carry out convergence and settlement monitoring of tunnel sections and surrounding structures.
* Coordinate with the Contractor's tunnel survey team on TBM guidance and as-built tunnel geometry.

**2.6 Infrastructure Utilities**

* Verify setting-out of water, sewerage, irrigation, district cooling, telecom, and electrical networks.
* Check trench alignment, invert levels, gradients, and connection points to existing utilities.
* Confirm chamber, manhole, and valve positions and levels.
* Coordinate with DEWA, DM Sewerage, Etisalat/du, and Empower surveyors during joint surveys and tie-ins.

**2.7 Topographic & Pre-Construction Surveys**

* Witness and verify topographic surveys, pre-construction condition surveys, and existing utility surveys carried out by the Contractor.
* Check existing levels, ground conditions, and surface features against design assumptions.
* Identify and report any discrepancies between design and existing site conditions to the Resident Engineer.

**2.8 Quantity Verification Support**

* Carry out joint surveys with the Contractor and Quantity Surveyor for measurement of earthworks (cut/fill), excavation, backfill, and pavement layers.
* Prepare cross-sections, longitudinal sections, and volume calculations using survey software (Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Trimble Business Center).
* Support the Quantity Surveyor with survey-based quantity verification for interim payment applications.

**2.9 As-Built Surveys & Records**

* Verify the Contractor's as-built surveys for all completed works and ensure compliance with project specifications and DM/RTA submission requirements.
* Check accuracy, completeness, and format of as-built drawings prior to recommendation for approval.
* Maintain a comprehensive As-Built Survey Register and ensure traceability to hand over documentation.

**2.10 Instruments & Calibration**

* Maintain Consultant's survey instruments (Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, automatic and digital levels, prisms, and accessories) in good working order.
* Verify that all Contractor's survey instruments are calibrated by accredited laboratories with valid certificates.
* Maintain a Calibration Register for all survey equipment used on the project.

**2.11 Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain comprehensive survey records: control sheets, setting out check sheets, level books, monitoring records, NCRs, and as-built data.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly survey activity reports for the Resident Engineer.
* Support authority audits and submissions to DM, RTA, and DEWA with verified survey data.

**2.12 Coordination & Reporting**

* Report directly to the Resident Engineer on all survey-related matters.
* Coordinate with Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and team.
* Attend technical meetings, progress reviews, and joint surveys with authorities.

**3. Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------

* **Education:** B.Sc. in Surveying / Geomatics / Civil Engineering, or a recognized Diploma in Land Surveying with relevant professional experience.
* **Experience:** Minimum 10 years' experience in land surveying on construction projects, with at least 7 years on major infrastructure projects (roads, bridges, tunnels, utilities) and a minimum of 3 years in the UAE/GCC.
* **Certifications:** Dubai Municipality / RTA approval as Land Surveyor is highly preferred.
* **Knowledge:** Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) projection, DMD vertical datum, DM and RTA survey specifications, geometric design standards, and infrastructure construction tolerances.
* **Skills:** Expert use of Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, digital levels, and 3D laser scanners. Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D. Good technical report writing, attention to detail, and effective communication.

**4. Reporting Line**
---------------------

The Land Surveyor reports directly to the Resident Engineer and works in close coordination with the Assistant Resident Engineer, Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and survey team.

* Advance OLG’s research and analytics practices by introducing fit-for-purpose methodologies, technologies and tools that improve the quality, speed, reliability and business value of customer insights
* Plan the annual market research budget and monitor the spending on research projects to ensure efficiency and eliminate duplication of efforts by bringing synergy between research projects
* Establish strong relationships with internal partners and external suppliers, and represent OLG’s customer research and insights perspective within ILC by influencing national research priorities, leading cross-jurisdictional projects and collaborating with working groups
* Lead, coach and develop Customer Insights Managers, strengthening their capabilities in research, analytics, storytelling and strategic business partnership
* Lead the bid management process, by drafting RFPs, analyzing and scoring proposals, to select and on-board research suppliers/vendors and liaise with procurement and legal departments to negotiate contracts for vendors/supplies
* Lead and evolve key customer insight capabilities, including customer panels, innovation research and the Customer Insights Hub, with strong governance, data quality and clear business use cases

**WHAT YOU BRING TO THE GAME**

***Education & Experience:***

* Bachelor’s Degree in commerce, economics, psychology, statistics or equivalent. A Master’s in one of these disciplines is an asset.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in customer insights, market research, customer intelligence or a related field, with strong quantitative research and analytical expertise

* Ability to independently interpret data tables, develop tabulation plans, conduct cross-tab and statistical analysis, investigate discrepancies and develop actionable recommendations
* Experience connecting survey and research findings with behavioural, transactional, customer and market data to create a holistic view of the customer and support product, channel, marketing, segmentation and customer experience strategies

The AI & Technical Security Standards Manager leads the development, maintenance, and implementation of global cybersecurity standards covering artificial intelligence and other technically complex security domains. The role converts strategic, regulatory, risk, and engineering requirements into clear, practical, and measurable standards that can be adopted consistently across Deloitte Global.

This is a technically focused management role requiring sufficient depth to evaluate emerging technologies, challenge assumptions, and hold credible discussions with security architects, engineers, data scientists, AI specialists, risk professionals, and other subject matter experts. The successful candidate will balance technical rigor with clear policy writing, and sound judgement.

The role works across Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to establish authoritative requirements, resolve complex standards questions, and support adoption. It also monitors developments in AI, cloud, software, infrastructure, and security engineering to ensure the standards portfolio remains relevant and forward-looking.

**Key Responsibilities**

***AI and technical security standards leadership***

* Own and manage the lifecycle (drafting, review, approval, publishing, maintenance) of Deloitte’s Global Cybersecurity policies and standards for AI and assigned technical security domains.
* Develop outcome-focused requirements that are technically credible, risk-based, and suitable for implementation across varied technology environments.
* Define security expectations for the design, development, acquisition, deployment, operation, and retirement of AI-enabled systems and supporting technology.
* Maintain new and revised standards, prioritized according to enterprise risk, regulatory change, technology adoption, and stakeholder need.
* Ensure AI-specific Deloitte Global Cybersecurity policies and standards are supported by clear guidance, control objectives, implementation considerations, and evidence expectations.

***Technical analysis and subject matter engagement***

* Lead detailed discussions with subject matter experts to understand technologies, threat scenarios, design constraints, and appropriate safeguards.
* Analyze architecture, engineering practices, threat intelligence, incidents, and control performance to identify where standards require clarification or enhancement.
* Translate complex technical concepts into concise requirements for technical and non-technical audiences without losing accuracy or intent.

**What will your typical day look like?**
-----------------------------------------

***AI security and emerging technology***

* Enhance Global Cybersecurity policies and standards for generative AI, machine learning, autonomous and agentic systems, AI platforms, models, data, integrations, and third-party AI services.
* Assess threats including prompt injection, insecure model and tool integration, sensitive data exposure, model manipulation, supply-chain compromise, excessive agency, and inadequate human oversight.
* Apply relevant industry and regulatory frameworks, including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and OWASP guidance, while adapting requirements to the organization’s risk context.

***Standards governance and assurance***

* Manage consultation, review, approval, publication, exception, and periodic review processes in accordance with the Global Cybersecurity Policy and Standards governance framework.
* Define measures for standards adoption and effectiveness, and provide clear reporting on implementation progress, material gaps, exceptions, and emerging risks.
* Support assurance and control teams in interpreting standards, evaluating evidence, and distinguishing material risk from implementation variance.

***Team leadership and talent development***

* Provide inclusive, visible, and accountable leadership to analysts on the team, setting clear direction and translating strategic priorities into achievable objectives.
* Build team capability through regular coaching, mentoring, constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and meaningful development opportunities, while fostering collaboration, technical curiosity, and high professional standards.
* Align internal resources, external vendors, and specialist expertise to business priorities; establish clear roles, governance, decision rights, service expectations, and SLAs; monitor capacity, program performance, delivery quality, risks, and dependencies.
* Recognize strong contributions; and promote ownership, resilience, and continuous improvement so that the team consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.

***Risk, regulatory, and industry alignment***

* Monitor changes in laws, regulations, contractual obligations, threat patterns, and recognized frameworks that affect AI and technical security requirements.
* Map standards to internal controls and external frameworks to support traceability, assurance, and regulatory response.
* Provide risk-based advice on deviations and exceptions, ensuring decisions, compensating controls, ownership, and remediation commitments are appropriately documented.

***Stakeholder leadership and enablement***

* Build productive relationships with stakeholders (Deloitte Firm SMEs), security and technology leaders, architects, engineers, product teams and risk owners.
* Chair working groups and facilitate constructive technical challenges to achieve clear, proportionate, and implementable requirements.
* Produce briefings and decision materials that help teams understand both the requirement and the risk it addresses.

The Senior Program Manager is the mesh between departments: connecting Business, Legal, Finance, Land and Regulatory, Power / IPP, Design, Procurement and Strategic Supply, Construction, Commissioning, Networking and Security, and Operations around one integrated plan.
  
  
The role owns the integrated plan, gate readiness, the cross-department interface log, RFS feasibility and recovery plans, and the weekly core team meeting. It coordinates and does not direct: functional leads keep their technical decisions, and contract and commercial approvals stay with Legal, Finance and the existing delegation of authority.

Integrated Planning & Gate Readiness
  
  

* Own the integrated plan and Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for the project, bringing together land, permit, power, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and operational readiness milestones.
* Manage the project through its full lifecycle, from site identification to handover to Operations: run kickoffs, hold readiness reviews about two weeks before each key decision point, and bring each one to a decision.
* Ensure each exit is met with evidence, and work with Program Controls, which assures every gate independently.
* Join early, at site identification, to frame the project plan and collect inputs from Land, Power, Design and Construction.

Cross-Functional Integration & Interface Management
  
  

* Maintain the interface log across departments, with clear owners, dates and closure evidence.
* Chair the weekly core team meeting and ensure decisions, actions and dependencies are tracked to closure.

* Surface gaps in ownership early, including OFCI versus CFCI scope, and escalate where functional teams are not aligned.

RFS Feasibility & Recovery
  
  

* Test RFS feasibility with Program Controls and subject-matter experts from Design, Power, Construction and Operations before dates are committed.
* Own recovery plans when external dependencies, such as power, OFCI delivery or utility schedules, threaten RFS dates.

Client & Commercial Alignment

* Lead client design sign-off and drive client acceptance at RFS.
* Support management of contract notices, claims and change requests with Legal and Finance, without taking over their approval authority.

Procurement, Construction & Commissioning Delivery

**Position Overview**

CINQCARE partners with the State of Indiana to strengthen care coordination for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, with OnQue, CINQCARE’s proprietary platform, serving as the foundation for that work. Reporting to the Regional Director, the Enablement Lead owns the enablement model and sets the playbook that state and CMO teams operate from. The Lead defines what good care coordination practice looks like in OnQue, makes sure teams have the guidance, tools, and cadence to work that way every day, and serves as a consultative resource to state and CMO leaders on operating standards and practice. The Lead also ensures the work of the Systems Enablement, Operations, and Performance Orchestrators comes together as one consistent approach.

**Key Responsibilities**

Enablement Model and Playbook

* Design, document, and own the enablement model for the Indiana IDD program, including roles, workflows, decision rights, and escalation paths.
* Define the operating standards for care coordination in OnQue, so state and CMO teams share a clear picture of what good practice looks like.
* Ensure standards reflect state program requirements, CMO realities, and person-centered practice for individuals with IDD.

Operating Cadence

* Set the operating cadence for the team and partners, including daily huddles, weekly reviews, monthly performance check-ins, and quarterly planning.
* Make sure each Orchestrator’s work has a clear place in that cadence, so guidance, platform use, daily execution, and performance follow-up connect.
* Ensure the cadence runs reliably, with clear agendas, owners, and follow-through on actions.

Playbook

* Build and maintain the Indiana playbook, including standard operating procedures, best-practice guides, job aids, and reference materials.

* Keep the playbook aligned with OnQue configuration and workflows, working with the Systems Enablement Orchestrator as the platform evolves.
* Update the playbook based on findings from the Performance Orchestrator and field input from the Operations Orchestrator, so it stays a living, trusted resource.

Consultative Support to CMOs

* Serve as a consultative resource to state and CMO leaders on operating standards, workflow design, and team practices.
* Help partner teams understand the playbook, why standards are set the way they are, and how to apply them in their own context.
* Gather partner feedback on what’s working and what isn’t and turn it into practical changes to standards and guidance.
* Provide the Regional Director with insight into partner practice and readiness to inform the overall relationship.

Performance, Quality, and Continuous Improvement

* Define enablement success measures, such as adherence to standard workflows, time to proficiency, and user confidence, and report on them regularly.
* Identify gaps in skills, process, or tooling and prioritize the fixes with the Systems Enablement Orchestrator and product teams.
* Run a structured feedback loop that captures user and CMO input and turns it into playbook updates and product feedback.

Team Leadership and Coordination

* Act as the connective point across the Systems Enablement, Operations, and Performance Orchestrators, keeping their work aligned to the enablement model.
* Coordinate with CINQCARE clinical, operations, product, and compliance teams so guidance stays accurate, consistent, and within contract scope.
* Share playbook-driven product feedback with OnQue product teams, in coordination with the Systems Enablement Orchestrator.

What Success Looks Like

* First 90 days: A documented enablement model and first version of the Indiana playbook are in place, and a regular operating cadence is running.
* Six months: The team works from consistent standards; CMO partners see the Lead as a go-to advisor, and enablement metrics are tracked and reviewed.
* Twelve months: The playbook is a living, trusted resource; measurable gains in consistency and proficiency are visible, and the model is ready to scale.

The Head of Enterprise Architecture (HEA) is responsible for establishing and leading Medica's enterprise architecture organization and ensuring Medica’s enterprise architecture aligns and enables, our business strategy, operating capabilities, technology, data, and processes, resulting in measurable and increasing enterprise value. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, the HEA serves as a strategic advisor to the CIO and senior business and technology leaders and leads a multidisciplinary architecture organization spanning enterprise, business, security, data, integration, and related architecture disciplines. The HEA also leads an enterprise-wide Architecture Community of Practice to align architects and architecture-adjacent roles around common principles, standards, methods, patterns, and decision practices.

Business Architecture is a foundational discipline of the practice. The HEA ensures a clear understanding of enterprise business objectives, the current and required state of business capabilities, and the value-aligned roadmaps needed to move from current to target state. These roadmaps integrate changes across technology, data, processes, organization, skills, and operating models. The role partners closely with the Office of the CIO, Enterprise Transformation, Business Process Re-engineering, Product Ownership, Engineering, Data, Security, and business leadership to translate strategy into executable change.

The HEA will evolve Enterprise Architecture from a traditional, centralized governance model toward an enabling, embedded, and delivery-oriented practice. Architecture will engage earlier and more deeply in strategic and day-to-day delivery, using reusable standards, reference architectures, patterns, guardrails, and risk-based decision frameworks to accelerate sound decisions. The HEA will also advance AI-enabled architecture practices to automate routine documentation, analysis, standards validation, knowledge management, and governance activities so architects can focus on solving critical business problems, transformation, complex design decisions, and delivery enablement.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Structure and Advance Enterprise Architecture Practices**

* Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise architecture strategy, operating model, principles, standards, methods, and practices.
* Establish Business Architecture as the connective layer between enterprise strategy, transformation, product portfolios, business processes, organizational design, data, and technology.
* Ensure development and maintenance of enterprise business capability models; partner to assess current-state maturity and identify capability gaps, dependencies, duplication, and investment needs.
* Translate enterprise strategy and business objectives into target states, transition states, and value-aligned capability roadmaps integrating changes to people, process, technology, data, organization, skills, and operating models.
* Provide enterprise leaders with clear views of strategic dependencies, tradeoffs, sequencing, technical health, and investment implications.
* Ensure technology strategy is traceable to business strategy and capability requirements.

**Deliver Enterprise Transformation & Strategy through Architecture**

* Serve as a strategic architecture advisor to the CIO, executive leadership, Transformation, Product, and business leaders.
* Partner with Enterprise Transformation and Business Process Re-engineering to connect strategic objectives, transformation portfolios, and process redesign to required business-capability changes.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to connect enterprise capability roadmaps with product strategies, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure architecture strategy reflects the operating, regulatory, data, and interoperability requirements of a healthcare organization, with particular emphasis on the health plan/payer environment.
* Provide architectural leadership for healthcare interoperability and industry standards, including X12 EDI, HL7 FHIR, USCDI, and other applicable healthcare information-exchange standards.
* Translate regulatory and interoperability requirements into enterprise capabilities and strategic roadmaps in partnership with Compliance, Legal, Security, Privacy, Product, Data, and business leaders.

**Architecture Enablement & Governance**

* Modernize the Architecture Review process from a primarily centralized approval mechanism into a risk-based architecture enablement model embedded earlier in strategy, discovery, design, and delivery.
* Establish reference architectures, reusable patterns, standards, guardrails, decision frameworks, and architecture decision records that increase delivery autonomy while maintaining enterprise alignment.
* Define clear decision rights across Enterprise Architecture, domain architecture, solution architecture, Engineering, Product, Security, Data, and related functions.
* Partner with engineering and technology leaders to evaluate and select strategic platforms, core technologies, architectural patterns, and engineering approaches.
* Guide modernization of core capabilities including Cloud, APIs, integration, data platforms, automation, AI, SaaS, and digital capabilities while reducing unnecessary complexity, duplication, and technical debt.
* Use AI and automation to improve architecture knowledge discovery, documentation, standards validation, impact analysis, dependency identification, and governance workflows, freeing architects for higher-value work.
* Measure architecture effectiveness through business outcomes, delivery enablement, reuse, simplification, risk reduction, technology health, and decision quality.

**Architecture Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and mentor a multidisciplinary architecture organization spanning enterprise, business, security, data, integration, and related architecture disciplines.
* Establish and lead an enterprise-wide Architecture Community of Practice encompassing architects and architecture-adjacent roles across centralized and distributed teams.
* Define common architecture principles, terminology, methods, artifacts, modeling approaches, standards, and expectations across the organization.
* Create mechanisms for knowledge sharing, reusable solutions, emerging practices, and lessons learned across the architecture community.
* Develop architecture talent, competency models, career paths, succession plans, and leadership capability across the enterprise.

* Operate effectively from executive strategy through delivery-level architecture, communicating complex business and technology concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Amazon's network is a key differentiator for AWS, enabling the global operation of thousands of applications across hundreds of thousands of servers worldwide. We are looking for a Network Development Manager to hire, manage, and develop a team of Network Development Engineers responsible for the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network. You will own capacity management and forecast planning, implementation, automation, change control, process management, and continuous improvement across the classified partitions. You will represent networking to service teams, infrastructure partners, and government stakeholders, ensuring we meet their needs for innovation, delivery, and safe operations in an environment where the margin for error is small and much of the tooling and telemetry commercial teams rely on has to be built.
  
  
At Amazon, we ask our technical leaders to be strong engineers who dive deep and help their engineers make sound decisions and deliver quality solutions. You will maintain a solid technical understanding of routing, switching, optical transport, and network automation, and ensure the right expertise exists on the team. You will also be a thoughtful people manager who mentors your engineers and builds an environment of mutual trust and respect, which matters even more in ADC where teams are smaller, more isolated, and carry a heavier operational load per person. The ideal candidate has a track record of driving operations and continuous improvement for large-scale, mission-critical networks, a passion for operational excellence, and the judgment to safely implement change, measure performance, and respond to events so the network always operates as intended.
  
  
The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network across the classified partitions: availability, performance, change control, and continuous improvement.
* Hire, develop, and retain a team of Network Development Engineers; own onboarding, career growth, 1:1s, and mentoring.

* Ensure network changes are designed, reviewed, and executed safely at scale under ADC's access and change-control constraints.
* Drive incidents and availability risks to resolution, and own Correction of Error (COE) follow-through so problems do not recur.

You lead a team of Network Development Engineers operating AWS's network inside classified regions. **Summary**
The Network Infrastructure Manager leads Great HealthWorks' Network Operations and Telecommunications teams — System Administrators, Systems Engineers, Telecom Administrator, and Telecom Engineer/Architect — and carries direct technical accountability for the network, systems, and telecom environments the team supports. This includes firewalls and routing, server, storage, and virtualization infrastructure, as well as the Company's carrier, voice platform, and contact center stack.
  
  
This is a technical leadership position balanced with operational execution. The Infrastructure Manager serves as the primary owner of day-to-day operations and escalations, the main point of contact for business and IT stakeholders, and the driving force behind resolving complex technical issues. This role directly owns the operational layer while remaining hands-on enough to review designs, troubleshoot escalated issues, and lead through major incidents. Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Directly manage and mentor the Network Operations team (System Administrators, Systems Engineers) and Telecommunications team (Telecom Administrator, Telecom Engineer/Architect); set technical priorities and hold the team to a high bar on quality
* Stay close enough to the environment to review designs and configurations, unblock hard technical problems, and lead the team through major incidents, including voice platform and contact center architecture decisions
* Hire and retain strong technical talent, conduct performance reviews, and manage staffing and on-call coverage for a 24/7 environment

Operational Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary day-to-day operational and escalation owner for Network Operations and Telecommunications — the first point of accountability when something breaks or a decision is needed
* Own communication with business and IT stakeholders on service health, incidents, and project status, serving as a transparent, trusted advisor to leadership.
* Translate technical issues into business impact, risk, and next steps for non-technical stakeholders and leadership
* Drive issue ownership and follow-through, ensuring every open issue has a clear owner, mitigation plan, and target resolution timeline.
* Coordinate across IT, vendors, and business teams to keep cross-functional work and vendor commitments moving
* Maintain visibility into service health, aging issues, recurring problems, and operational risk, and surface it proactively rather than waiting to be asked
* Define and apply clear criteria for what gets escalated to IT leadership versus what this role is expected to own and resolve independently

Network, Systems & Security Operations
  
  

* Own network security (firewall), routing and switching, EDR, and DNS filtering

* Own Microsoft 365 administration and build out the team's SharePoint administration capability
* Own AWS, Cloudflare, and integration of the broader SaaS footprint, plus server backup and disaster recovery
* Maintain PCI compliance across in-scope systems, ensure SLAs are met, and drive capacity planning and script/automation practices across the team

Telecommunications Operations
  
  

* Own operation of the Company's custom-built phone system, voice and data carrier services, and the contact center platform (e.g., NICE InContact/CXone), including the design and engineering work done by the Telecom Engineer/Architect

* Ensure telecom integrations (contact center, voice platform, speech IVR, SMS) stay supported and issues are triaged quickly

Planning, Documentation & Vendor Management
  
  

* Scope infrastructure and telecom projects up front — gather real requirements, build workable schedules, and keep initiatives on track

* Manage vendor and carrier relationships and contracts, build business cases for technology investments, and own the network/systems/telecom budget

* Experience scoping and running technical projects — gathering requirements and managing timelines — without a dedicated PM function
* Experience as the primary operational and escalation owner for a technical team, including regular communication with non-technical business stakeholders
* Strong understanding of ITIL and formal change management

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Deep, current technical knowledge of networking (OSI, TCP/IP, routing/switching), firewalls, and identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta)
* Hands-on experience with Windows and Linux administration, enterprise storage (Nimble/QNAP/Quantum), and virtualization (XCP-NG or equivalent)
* Experience with AWS, Cloudflare, Microsoft 365, and integrating a broad SaaS footprint; SharePoint administration a plus
* Experience with carrier/telecom management, contact center platforms, and PCI compliance

• 5+ years of hands-on Major Incident Management experience in complex enterprise technology environments.

• ITIL Foundation certification required.

• ITIL 4 Practitioner: Incident Management certification preferred.

• Additional advanced ITIL certifications related to Incident Management, service operations, or service management preferred.

• Demonstrated experience leading high-impact, business-critical technology incidents through mitigation and service restoration.

• Demonstrated experience operating in a high-volume Major Incident environment, including managing multiple Major Incidents concurrently.

• Extensive experience leading technical and management bridge calls involving multiple technical teams, SI partners, and support organizations.

• Proven ability to drive teams toward service restoration while maintaining urgency, accountability, organization, and focus in high-pressure situations.

• Strong management and stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical situations into clear and concise business communications.

• General technical understanding of enterprise application and infrastructure architecture, including applications, servers, databases, networks, cloud services, integrations, and service dependencies.

• Strong understanding of Major Incident Management practices, including impact, urgency, prioritization, escalation, communications, and service restoration.

• Strong decision-making, analytical, and organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and multiple technical workstreams simultaneously.

• Experience working in complex multi-provider or SI environments preferred.

• Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise service management platform.

• Ability to work effectively with the SMO Global Process Owner, SI Major Incident Managers, SI partners, technical teams, and management stakeholders.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate Major Incidents from declaration through mitigation or service restoration, maintaining urgency and focus on minimizing business impact.

• Lead technical and management bridge calls, ensuring the appropriate SI partners and technical resources are engaged and focused on service restoration.

• Drive SI Major Incident Managers and technical teams to maintain urgency, accountability, clear ownership, and progress throughout the incident.

• Manage multiple concurrent Major Incidents while prioritizing activities based on business impact, urgency, and service criticality.

• Coordinate troubleshooting activities across application, infrastructure, network, cloud, database, and other technical teams while maintaining focus on service restoration.

• Establish and track actions, owners, escalation points, and next steps throughout the Major Incident lifecycle.

• Identify and escalate technical, resource, ownership, or organizational barriers that are delaying service restoration.

• Provide timely, accurate, and concise Major Incident communications to management, stakeholders, and affected organizations.

• Ensure SI partners follow established Major Incident response, escalation, communication, and contractual SLA requirements.

• Work with the SIAM team to identify and address SI partner performance issues, recurring concerns, coordination gaps, and areas requiring follow-up or corrective action.

• Maintain accurate Major Incident timelines, actions, decisions, communications, mitigation activities, and restoration information.

• Support post-incident activities and ensure relevant information is captured for Problem Management, follow-up actions, and continual improvement.

• Work with the SMO Global Process Owner to identify opportunities to improve Major Incident Management execution and SI partner performance.

• Work with the SMO Global Process Owner to identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve Major Incident Management, including documenting business requirements and supporting the development and adoption of new capabilities.

• Ensure Major Incident activities are executed in accordance with established processes, procedures, escalation paths, and governance requirements.

Our clients now hand us security addendums before kickoff, expect SOC 2 reports and annual risk questionnaires, write US-only data processing into their contracts, and audit us as a delegated entity under Medicare rules. Meanwhile our own engineers are running two laptops each, model-provider API keys are managed by hand, and nobody can tell you where every machine is. You will own all of it: the help queue, the device fleet, the security program, the compliance evidence, and the operational side of the AI stack that runs our business.

This is a build role and a player-coach role. You’ll write the policy and ship the laptop in the same afternoon. The mandate is right-sized: we scope controls to the obligations we actually have and add more when a contract or an audit finding says to, not because a framework says we might need it someday. Success in the first year looks like a clear device baseline, a passed SOC 2 Type I with Type II underway, security questionnaires answered in days instead of weeks, and a picture of what we spend on models and why.

**What You Get To Do**
----------------------

### ***Run the shop***

* Own the internal help queue end to end. Blank Metal engineers are fast and impatient; you’ll keep them that way by making account setup, access, and troubleshooting a same-day thing.
* Build the device lifecycle we don’t have yet: procurement and vendor relationships, imaging, mobile device management, inventory, loaners, repairs, and retirement. You’ll know where every laptop is and whose it is.
* Make onboarding and offboarding a checklist that runs in hours for employees and contractors alike, including the client-issued machines and accounts that come with each engagement.
* Administer the core stack (Google Workspace, 1Password, Slack, Zoom, GitHub) with sane access policies, and be the person who says no to the fourth note-taking app.
* Own the hardware and software budget and get us to a standard kit, with spares on the shelf, without overspending.

### ***Make security something we can prove***

* Take Blank Metal through SOC 2: pick the compliance automation platform, scope the controls to our real obligations, run the audit, and keep the evidence current.
* Be the standing answer to client security questionnaires, security addendums, and data protection exhibits, working alongside our outside counsel so what we commit to is what we can actually do.
* Write and own the policies that are missing today (access control, data retention and destruction, acceptable use, device, incident response) and make them short enough that people follow them.
* Serve as the technical counterpart to our healthcare compliance program, translating Medicare- and HIPAA-regulated requirements into controls engineers can live with.
* Review the tools we adopt (AI note-takers, browser extensions, SaaS) against what our client contracts allow, before someone connects them.

### ***Keep the AI stack accountable***

* Own the accounts, API keys, and access to our model providers and cloud environments, with rotation, scoping, and attribution by client and project.
* Stand up usage and cost observability for model spend so leadership can see token cost by engagement, tie it to margin, and catch surprises before the invoice does.
* Enforce data residency and handling rules for AI workloads, including US-only processing, no-training clauses, and environment isolation for client data.
* Provision secure, repeatable working environments for engineers and contractors, so a new team member is productive on day one without a security exception.

* You can read a security addendum and tell a lawyer, in plain English, which clauses we can sign and which we can’t.
* A right-sizer by instinct. You scope controls to real obligations, say when something is over-built, and sequence investment on evidence rather than fear.
* You write clearly. Policies, questionnaire answers, and Slack replies that people actually read and act on.
* Patient with the help queue and unbothered by it. Reimaging a laptop is not beneath you, and neither is presenting to leadership.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* Craft meets velocity: we obsess over quality while delivering at startup speed
* Outcome-driven model: our work aligns with client success, not billable hours

**About Neurophos**

The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach.

Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large-scale AI inference.

Our mission is to provide high-quality, sustainable flooring solutions and sundries, serving a wide range of customers, including residential to commercial contractors, subcontractors, and designers. Through expert advice, personalized service, and extensive product selection, we support our customers in creating functional and durable spaces. We are dedicated to building lasting relationships by equipping our team with deep product knowledge and a commitment to excellence in everything we do.

**Summary/Objective:**

The truck driver position performs a variety of routine and complex transportation work in driving and coordinating transportation plans. The Truck Driver is responsible for the safe and timely delivery of goods to our customers. You will be tasked with driving and maintaining trucks that will be assigned to you as well as working closely with our team in order to plan routes and track deliveries.

**Essential Functions:**

* Accurately pulling orders for delivery in a timely and safe manner.
* Properly and efficiently unloading cargo/trucks and checks with Supervisor upon completion for next delivery instruction/information.
* Properly and efficiently completing Pre/Post Vehicle Inspections on daily basis.
* Maintaining truck logs according to company policy and Federal/State regulations.
* Fueling, washings and maintaining vehicles as needed/required per Company policy.
* Maintaining contact with the Warehouse Manager as needed/required.
* Safely and accurately operating warehouse equipment at all times to load, unload, or disperse cargo and/or materials.
* Physically inspecting items for damage as needed and/or requested by the customer.
* Inspecting shipments/equipment as needed.
* Contacting his/her supervisor in the event a customer wants to make changes to a delivery.
* Drive long distances to deliver goods to customers.
* Keep commercial driver license up to date.
* Maintain a positive attitude with customers.
* May plan route to insure most economical use of time and equipment.
* Perform all duties in conformance to appropriate safety and security standards.

**Requirements**

* Class A CDL or commercial driver license.
* Must be able to drive a manual truck.
* Must have clean driving record.
* Must provide a medical certificate.

**Competencies**

* Discretion.
* Decision Making.
* Time Management.
* Thoroughness.
* Customer/Client Focus.

**Work Environment**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee frequently works in outside weather conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals and vibration.

**Physical Demands**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk and hear. The employee is constantly required to use hands and fingers to feel, handle or operate objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl and walk.

Job Overview  
We are seeking a Learning Solutions Manager to manage the design and implementation of enterprise-wide development learning programs and curricula, including AI literacy and enablement, to build capabilities across multiple roles and career transitions. It consults on needs and leads the development, coordination, and quality assurance of learning solutions aligned with enterprise curricula and consults with teams to ensure effective capability building. Working with the operations team to ensure deployment of learning is effective, you will sometimes also facilitate delivery. The role differentiates by integrating innovative systems thinking, learning frameworks, managing vendor relationships, and embedding inclusion and responsible AI principles into design and facilitation practices. Success is measured by the alignment, quality, and impact of learning deliverables, including AI adoption and applied usage, as well as effective collaboration with partners and vendor management. The work supports organizational talent development and enhances employee growth and AI fluency, contributing to overall business performance and culture.

-------------------------

* Design and manage enterprise development programs and curricula to build capabilities across roles and career transitions, including role-based AI learning paths from awareness to applied use.

* Carry out instructional design, oversee deployment and facilitate if necessary, ensuring quality deliverables to meet agreed business needs.
* Lead quality assurance processes to ensure learning meets standards of accuracy, alignment, and audience relevance, including responsible AI use.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and AI subject matter experts to align learning content and incorporate feedback into curricula.
* Partner with Data and AI teams, AI Champions, and business units to build hands-on AI learning (workshops, hackathons) tied to real work use cases.
* Measure AI adoption and productivity impact; keep content current as AI tools evolve
* Evaluate AI learning vendors and platforms.
* Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed.

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience OR advanced degree with 1 year of related work experience OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent.
* 5+ years of experience focused on designing development experiences for leadership development, including developing learning content using generative AI tools.
* Experience designing and developing engaging, scalable learning solutions that build employee capabilities and support business objectives.
* Ability to confidently present ideas, communicate recommendations, and influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Experience evaluating and managing external learning vendors and technology partners to ensure quality, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery.
* Experience designing learning solutions that combine instructor-led, virtual, digital, and self-paced learning experiences.
* Ability to connect business needs with practical learning strategies, seeking opportunities to improve employee capabilities and performance.
* Strong relationship-building and consulting skills, with the ability to understand business needs, align priorities, and collaborate across teams.
* Experience managing learning initiatives from planning through execution, including timelines, deliverables, partner coordination, and measuring outcomes.
* Experience using LMS platforms to deploy, manage, track, and report on learning programs and learner engagement.
* Working knowledge of generative AI and its business applications, with the ability to develop learning experiences that build employee AI fluency and adoption.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, bias, and ethical considerations, and how to incorporate them into learning content.
* Experience supporting organizational change through learning, communications, and engagement strategies that encourage adoption of new tools and processes.
* Hands-on proficiency using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Microsoft Copilot to develop learning content, improve workflows, and drive productivity.

* Experience measuring AI adoption and productivity impact.
